lines: You woke up today... and everyone was gone.
No people. No cars moving. No voices.
Or at least... that's what you think.
No signal. And every clock you find... says six twelve.
You search the city for hours.
A bird hangs in the air... mid-flight.
Steam over a coffee cup... frozen like glass.
The second they vanished... everything stopped.
On the third night... you notice the cameras.
Then every single one... turns to follow you.
You tell yourself it's a glitch. You're tired. You're seeing things.
Until your reflection... takes one more step than you do.
You run home. You lock every door.
Then, for the first time in three days... your phone buzzes.
Sent from your own number... one minute ago.
But you haven't slept in three days.
So who's sleeping in your bed?
So who's been watching you sleep?
